## Example

The traits of the picture above:

```python
ai.Sparkline(label="Sparkline", unit="m", format="%.2f")
```

The data of the picture (samples, history or drawing) is sent with the widget's methods,
not as traits: see the [widget catalog](../widgets.md).

## Traits

| Trait | Type | Default | Set by | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `"control"`, `"indicator"` | `"indicator"` | host | "control": the user sets the value; "indicator": display only. |
| `size` | array | `[160,36]` | host | [width, height] in CSS pixels. |
| `value` | number | `"nan"` | host | Last appended value, written by the host with each append (the view shows the newest value of its history when it has one). |
| `history` | integer | `60` | host | Number of values kept and drawn. |
| `unit` | string | `""` | host |  |
| `format` | string | `"%.4g"` | host | printf-like spec of the last value (NUM-004). |
